voices.name: l00
voices.text: Does one comment stay with you <#0.2#> for days?
voices.caption: Does one comment stay with you for days?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Do crowds leave you <#0.2#> completely drained?
voices.caption: Do crowds leave you completely drained?

voices.name: l02
voices.text: About one in five people <#0.2#> is born feeling far more finely.
voices.caption: About one in five people is born feeling far more finely.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: They notice what others miss, <#0.2#> and read what isn't said.
voices.caption: They notice what others miss, and read what isn't said.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: You tire easily not because you're weak, <#0.2#> but because you take in so much.
voices.caption: You tire easily not because you're weak, but because you take in so much.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: You're not too sensitive. <#0.3#> You're deeply gifted.
voices.caption: You're not too sensitive. You're deeply gifted.
